FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE

THE order under section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.

The Order

By virtue of the powers vested in me under section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907 as amended by Act No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I, the Minister of Environment do by this Order declare the state land of the extent 441.63 hectares located in the area bounded by the limits set forth in the schedule 1 to 10 and except the land area bounded by the limits set forth in the Schedule 11 to 13 given below, as Kottawa Reserved Forest from 02nd day of June 2025.

Dammika Patabendi, Minister of Environment.

Ministry of Environment,Sobadam Piyasa, 416/C/1, Robert Gunawardana Mawatha, Battaramulla,02nd June, 2025.

Forest Conservation Ordinance

NOTIFICATION

By virtue of powers vested in me, under section 63 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No.16 of 1907 as amended by Acts No.13 of 1966(reprint), No.56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I do by this notification notify that the Kottawa Reserved Forest mentioned in the above order is sub-jected to the sole control of the Conservator General of Forests.

Dammika Patabendi, Minister of Environment.

Ministry of Environment,Sobadam Piyasa, 416/C/1, Robert Gunawardana Mawatha, Battaramulla,02nd June, 2025.
